videos.title: How to Stand Out When Everyone Is Launching
videos.description: Every network that exists today is trained to make sure nobody builds a network on top of it. a16z's Anish Acharya on why growth just became a word of mouth problem again.

videos.title: AI's Gap Is a Product Design Failure
videos.description: People don't actually want to be more productive. More people want to spend time than save time. a16z's Anish Acharya on the product design failure holding back AI.

videos.title: Why Grok Bot's Team Is Colleague-Pilled
videos.description: SpaceXAI's Roman Ugarte shares how the Grok Bot team is “colleague-pilled” not AGI-pilled

videos.title: The AI Opportunity That Nobody's Building
videos.description: a16z General Partner, Anish Acharya explains why there’s a big opportunity in consumer software.

videos.title: The best hires aren't looking for jobs
videos.description: The best hires aren't on the market. SpaceXAI's Roman Ugarte on why recruiting starts with problems, not resumes.

videos.title: Moats are a byproduct, not a plan
videos.description: Cursor didn't win by planning a moat. SpaceXAI's Roman Ugarte on why obsession with today beats strategy for tomorrow.

videos.title: Moats Are Discovered, Not Designed
videos.description: Cursor got criticized for having no moat. Then it captured every reasoning trace and trained its own models. a16z's Anish Acharya on why moats can be discovered, not designed.

videos.title: Why CEOs Should Not Be Away from Product
videos.description: There are two ways founders kill their own companies. Not letting go. And getting too far away.

videos.title: The Permanent Underclass Is a Fantasy
videos.description: The most sophisticated people at the labs say it's not recursive self-improvement. a16z's Anish Acharya on why the permanent underclass isn't happening.

videos.description: Einstein wouldn't invent relativity today. He'd be deleting LinkedIn notifications and getting Slacked mid-equation.
